# Elecrow CrowView Note 15.6" — Portable lapdock monitor with keyboard

**Category:** Monitor (lapdock)
**MSRP:** $159.90 (Elecrow direct; sold on Amazon as "ELECROW 15.6" Portable Monitor with Keyboard, Lapdock 1080P FHD IPS Display")

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Model | CrowView Note 15.6" (SKU DLC44156D) |
| Screen size | 15.6 in |
| Panel type | IPS |
| Resolution | 1920 × 1080 (FHD) |
| Aspect ratio | 16:9 |
| Refresh rate | 60 Hz |
| Brightness | 300 nits |
| Color gamut | 100% sRGB / 72% NTSC |
| Hinge | 180° flip |
| Battery | 6000 mAh built-in, ~2–3 hours continuous use |
| Power input | USB-C PD: 5V/3A, 9V/3A, 12V/3A, 15V/3A |
| Power output | 5V/5A PD reverse charging (enough to power a Raspberry Pi 5 directly) |
| Ports | 1× USB-C (power in), 1× USB-C (full-featured: video/data/power), 1× USB-C (power out), 1× Mini HDMI, 2× USB-A |
| Keyboard | 101-key, integrated touchpad |
| Audio | Dual speakers, built-in microphone |
| Camera | None |
| Compute | None — no CPU, RAM, or storage; display/input terminal only |
| Supported OS | Windows, macOS, ChromeOS, Linux, Android, Raspberry Pi OS (Bookworm), Nintendo Switch, PS4/PS5 |
| Supported SBCs | Raspberry Pi 5/4B/3B/3B+/Zero, Nvidia Jetson Nano, Arduino UNO Q, Rock Pi, Orange Pi 4B, LattePanda V1, Banana Pi M5, BeagleBone |
| Phone desktop mode | Samsung DeX-capable Galaxy S8+ / Note8+ / Fold series get desktop mode; other USB-C phones mirror only |
| Material / color | ABS + PC, grey |
| Dimensions | 372 × 244 × 26 mm |
| Weight | 1545 g (shipping weight 2200 g) |
| In the box | Lapdock, power adapter, USB-C to USB-C cable, USB-A to USB-A cable, HDMI to Mini HDMI cable, user manual |
| Optional add-ons | Raspberry Pi 5 bridge board (+$6.90), Jetson Nano Dev Kit bridge board (+$6.90) |

## Notable Features
- Single-cable operation over full-featured USB-C — video, data (keyboard/touchpad/USB hub), and power all on one link; no drivers required.
- 5V/5A PD output can power a Raspberry Pi 5 or top up a connected phone from the lapdock's own battery.
- Two USB-A ports act as a hub passed through to the connected device.
- F1 key switches between the USB-C and HDMI input sources when both are connected.
- Optional bridge boards mount a Pi 5 or Jetson Nano directly to the chassis for a self-contained SBC laptop.
- Larger-screen follow-up to the original 14" CrowView Note, aimed at programming, design, and video work.
